# Precious Okoro

> Precious Okoro is a senior content designer and conversation designer. She builds the language infrastructure behind products: content systems, knowledge bases, UX writing, and the conversation and trust design behind AI agents. Her work spans fintech, SaaS, edtech, and intelligent systems.

## Case studies

- [Moniger: content system for a multi-bank fintech app](https://www.preciousokoro.site/moniger): a content-first system that lifted conversions 25% and reduced onboarding drop-off 8%.
- [FastTrackUX: research-led content for two audiences](https://www.preciousokoro.site/fasttrackux): student logins nearly doubled after a single shared hero.
- [Beacon: a single incident taxonomy for engineering teams](https://www.preciousokoro.site/beacon): misclassification dropped 62% after consolidating severity labels.
- [Payr: a concept for AI agent trust and action language](https://www.preciousokoro.site/payr-case-study): a conversation and trust design project for an AI savings agent.
